item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】DSF - Donald Fagen - Kamakiriad (2026 MoFi SACD. DSD & CD layers)
item.description:
Hello everyone! Guess who's back?

It's been a while and I've missed you all. Today i bring to you a new MoFi SACD that I just got from FedEx:

Donald Fagen - Kamakiriad (DSD64 + CD Layer)


This is, in my humble opinion, the best and THE ONLY version everyone will likely ever need.
This album has always been know for its clinical sound profile, and MoFi brought it back to a new life with their mastering.

Tracklist:
1.- Trans-Island Skyway
2.- Countermoon
3.- Springtime
4.- Snowbound
5.- Tomorrow's Girls
6.- Florida Room
7.- On The Dunes
8.- Teahouse On The Tracks

Enjoy! And see you soon until next time (or until MoFi's SACD for Michael Jackson's "Bad" releases and ships).
